summary: Ideally positioned within the heart of Eastbourne, this exceptional three-bedroom family home enjoys a highly convenient location within easy reach of a wealth of local amenities, highly regarded schools, excellent transport links, the mainline railway station and the vibrant town centre.
description:
The town centre offers an abundance of shops, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities, the location perfectly balances everyday convenience with a strong sense of community, making it particularly appealing to families and commuters alike. Immaculately presented throughout, this stylish home has been lovingly maintained and thoughtfully improved by the current owners to create a stylish and welcoming living environment. Boasting spacious and versatile accommodation, contemporary décor and quality fixtures and fittings throughout, the property is perfectly suited to modern family living and offers a true 'move straight in' opportunity for prospective purchasers. Upon entering, a welcoming entrance porch leads into the heart of the home, where bright and well-proportioned living spaces create an immediate sense of warmth and comfort. The spacious lounge provides an inviting setting for relaxation, whilst the separate dining room offers the ideal space for family meals, entertaining guests and special occasions. The well-appointed kitchen has been designed with both practicality and style in mind, providing ample storage and workspace to cater for the demands of everyday life. To the first floor, the property continues to impress with three well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering comfortable accommodation and flexibility for growing families, home working or guest accommodation. Completing the internal accommodation is a modern family bathroom, designed to serve the needs of contemporary family living. Externally, the property offers equally impressive outdoor space. To the front, a substantial block-paved driveway provides generous off-road parking for multiple vehicles, a feature increasingly sought after by today's buyers. Gated side access leads through to the extensive rear garden, a true highlight of the property and a wonderful extension of the living space during the warmer months. This superb home presents a rare opportunity to acquire a property that truly caters for modern family life. Early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space and lifestyle on offer.

ENTRANCE PORCH Accessed via a UPVC framed double-glazed entrance door, the welcoming entrance porch provides an attractive introduction to the property. Benefiting from UPVC framed double-glazed windows, the space is flooded with natural light, creating a bright and airy first impression for visitors and serves as a useful transition into the main living accommodation, with a door leading through to the lounge.

LOUNGE A spacious and beautifully proportioned principal reception room, enjoying an abundance of natural light through a large UPVC framed double-glazed bay-style window to the front elevation. The bay window not only enhances the sense of space but also creates an attractive focal point within the room. The generous dimensions offer ample space for a range of lounge furniture, creating a comfortable setting for both everyday family living and entertaining guests. Further benefiting from a radiator, the room enjoys a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout the year. A door leads through to the dining room, creating a natural flow between the reception spaces and enhancing the sociable layout of the home.

DINING ROOM A stylish and versatile dining room positioned to the rear of the property, thoughtfully designed to create an ideal space for both family dining and entertaining. The room is enhanced by attractive wood flooring and a striking feature wood-panelled wall with integrated illumination, adding warmth, character and a contemporary touch to the space. There is ample room to accommodate a family-sized dining table and chairs, making it the perfect setting for everyday meals and social gatherings alike. Natural light is provided via a UPVC framed double-glazed window, whilst a radiator ensures comfort. Further benefits include a useful under-stairs storage cupboard, ideal for household items and additional storage needs. The room enjoys an open-plan aspect through to the kitchen, creating a sociable flow between the living spaces and perfectly suited to modern family living.

KITCHEN The kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with both style and functionality in mind, featuring a range of contemporary base and wall-mounted units complemented by elegant granite work surfaces and contrasting splashbacks, creating a sleek and modern finish. An inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap is perfectly positioned beneath the UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing for pleasant natural light whilst undertaking day-to-day tasks. There is dedicated space for a cooker with extractor canopy over, together with plumbing for an automatic washing machine, space for a tumble dryer and ample room to accommodate an American-style fridge freezer, catering perfectly to the needs of modern family living. The continuation of the attractive wood flooring from the dining room enhances the seamless flow between the living spaces, whilst the open-plan layout creates a sociable environment ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. Completing the room are UPVC framed double-glazed French doors opening directly onto the rear garden, allowing natural light to flood the space and providing an excellent connection between the indoor and outdoor living areas, particularly during the warmer months.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to all first-floor accommodation and continues the property's well-presented and contemporary feel. A stylish wood and glass balustrade creates an attractive architectural feature, enhancing the sense of space and light whilst adding a modern touch to the interior. The landing also benefits from loft access, providing convenient access to additional storage space, and serves as a bright and welcoming central point to the first-floor accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE A generously proportioned double bedroom provides a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing for an abundance of natural light and creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The room offers ample space for a double bed alongside a range of freestanding wardrobes and additional bedroom furniture, making it a comfortable and practical principal bedroom. Further benefiting from a radiator, the room provides a relaxing retreat and is well-suited to the needs of modern family living.

BEDROOM TWO A well-proportioned bedroom enjoying natural light from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, creating a bright and comfortable space. Benefiting from a radiator, the room offers versatile accommodation and could be utilised as a spacious bedroom, guest room, nursery or home office depending on the needs of the purchaser. A particular feature of the room is the direct access through to Bedroom Three, providing a flexible arrangement that could lend itself well to a dressing room, nursery, home office or children's bedroom, offering a variety of options to suit modern family living.

BEDROOM THREE A bright and versatile bedroom benefiting from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing for plenty of natural light throughout the day. The room is served by a radiator and offers flexible accommodation, making it ideally suited as a child's bedroom, nursery, home office or hobby room. Further benefiting from loft access, the room provides convenient access to additional storage space whilst maintaining its practical and adaptable appeal. The versatility of this room makes it an excellent addition to the family accommodation, capable of adapting to a variety of lifestyle requirements.

FAMILY BATHROOM Beautifully appointed and finished in a contemporary style, the family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset mains-fed shower over, a wash hand basin and low-level WC, both neatly set within a stylish vanity unit providing useful concealed storage. Contemporary panelled walls create a sleek, low-maintenance finish whilst enhancing the overall aesthetic of the room. Further benefiting from a radiator and a UPVC framed double-glazed window, the bathroom enjoys plenty of natural light and ventilation, creating a bright and relaxing space perfectly suited to the demands of modern family living.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property, a generous block-paved driveway provides ample off-road parking for multiple vehicles, offering both convenience and practicality for modern family living. Gated side access leads seamlessly through to the impressive rear garden. A particular highlight of the property, the substantial rear garden has been thoughtfully designed to create an enjoyable outdoor space for all ages. Immediately adjoining the property is an attractive raised timber-decked patio, providing the perfect setting for al fresco dining, summer barbecues and relaxing with family and friends. The garden continues with a combination of paved and gravelled areas, offering low-maintenance seating spaces, whilst the generous AstroTurf area provides an excellent area for children to play. Fully enclosed by fencing, the garden offers a safe and private environment, ideal for both families and pet owners. A useful timber storage shed provides excellent space for gardening equipment and outdoor furniture, whilst beyond lies a further section of garden, presenting additional opportunities for landscaping, vegetable growing, children's play equipment or simply enjoying the generous outdoor space on offer. The impressive size, versatility and privacy of the rear garden make it a wonderful extension of the living accommodation and a standout feature of this family home.
